**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 18 of the agreement satisfies the INSURANCE rule at the **preferred** position (not merely the fallback):

| Playbook preferred requirement | § 18.1 |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M occurrence / 2M aggregate | ✅ Exact match |
| Professional (E&O) USD 2M | ✅ Exact match |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M (data processors) | ✅ Exact match — appropriate as Brightline hosts Customer Data |
| Workers' compensation as required by law | ✅ Present, plus employer's liability USD 1M (extra) |
| Certificates on request | ✅ § 18.2 |

Section 18.2 goes beyond the preferred ask in our favour: reputable insurers, primary to Customer's insurance where commercially customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and an express non-limitation statement confirming insurance does not cap Vendor's liabilities.

All obligations run against Brightline and benefit Northwind, so there is nothing to negotiate here. The only sub-preferred nuances are soft qualifiers ("where commercially customary" on primacy, "to the extent available from its insurer" on cancellation notice) — these are ordinary market carve-outs, not material terms, and per playbook convention they are noted rather than flagged.
